definitions.vertical_acceleration: central second difference of recorded chassis position; landing traces sampled at 30 Hz, ground/contact at 240 Hz; this includes gravity response, collisions and engine/control work
definitions.rms: zero-referenced RMS, not oscillatory amplitude; compression peak-to-peak reported separately
definitions.contact_interruptions: includes initial airborne interval; zero-load and missing-road contacts both count
definitions.windows: first_second is common fixed t<1 s; whole_run includes falls and diverging paths; no post-crash censoring
definitions.energy: powered whole-bike kinetic changes are not a closed energy budget; see independent unpowered tire and fixed-mount suspension probes
